verdict: One issue needs attention soon, plus 5 smaller one(s).

findings.title: /mnt/sdc1 is 99.5% full
findings.body: /mnt/sdc1 is 99.5% used (3.8 GiB of 830 GiB free). Writes to a nearly full drive get slow.
findings.action: Free space or move data elsewhere.

findings.title: /media/buengenio/sda4 is 90.5% full
findings.body: /media/buengenio/sda4 is 90.5% used (62.9 GiB of 661 GiB free). Writes to a nearly full drive get slow.
findings.action: Free space or move data elsewhere.

findings.title: Processor is about 9 years old
findings.body: Intel Core i7-7500U (~2017). A current mid-range CPU is roughly 2–4× faster per core and has 3–4× the cores.

findings.title: Battery holds 45.3% of its original capacity
findings.body: 45.3% health, 1729 cycles. Below ~60% a replacement is worth it if you use it unplugged.
findings.action: Replace the battery if portability matters.

findings.title: System is under heavy load
findings.body: 5-minute load average 13.6 on 4.0 CPUs. Something is saturating the processor.

findings.title: Waiting on disks 34.7% of the time
findings.body: I/O wait is 34.7%. A slow or busy drive (often USB) is holding everything else up.

findings.title: Memory cannot be upgraded
findings.body: 16 GB LPDDR3 is soldered. Whatever you have now is the ceiling for this machine.

findings.title: Drive health could not be read
findings.body: SMART data was unavailable (needs smartmontools and usually elevated rights).
findings.action: Install smartmontools and rerun with elevated rights.

findings.title: Only 2 CPU cores
findings.body: 2 cores / 4 threads. Fine for everyday use; compiles, video and container stacks will be CPU-bound.

findings.title: Graphics are built into the processor
findings.body: Integrated HD Graphics 620. Hardware video decode works; GPU compute and gaming are out of reach.

findings.title: Swap is configured
findings.body: 12.0 GiB of swap is available (8.0 GiB (File, prio 5), 4.0 GiB (Zram, prio 100)). Memory spikes will slow things down rather than kill programs.

findings.title: Fast NVMe system drive
findings.body: KINGSTON SNV2S2000G (1.8 TiB) on NVMe PCIe 8.0 GT/s x4. Storage is not your bottleneck.

capabilities.label: Portable home/cloud server (self-hosted services on the go)
On-device AI: classify, index, small models
